title: Row 9, objectstack half: `get_record_context` joins `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE` and gets its `chatbot.tool` label in every locale
body:
maintainer · os-bob · session_012dn2AecKpLaYkUtNRiqtby

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed (topic child). Source: topic #36996, M2. ADR-0160's implementation split note says row 9 "has a half in this repository". The independent Fable review of rows 5–10 (2026-11-25) found it carried only inside the cloud card, which leaves this repository's PR without a card to `Fixes`. Maintainer 2026-11-25: 「同意你的建议」.
Grading: area:ai · Task · p2 (topic child) · reach: the product AI's tool list and its labels · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：平台的「云端注册了哪些工具」清单加上 `get_record_context`，11 个语言包都加上这个工具在对话里显示的名称（比如中文「读取记录资料」）。
- 为什么：这是 cloud 应用内对话注册这个工具（cloud#4978）在本仓的另一半。清单里的分组必须和 cloud 包实际注册的工具完全一致，所以两边要一起落地。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
1. `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts#PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE`: add `get_record_context` to the group of the cloud package that registers it (`@objectstack/service-ai`, per cloud#4978).
2. `chatbot.tool.get_record_context` labels in every pack under `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/`: ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant.
3. Remove the expected `validate-ai-tool-references.ts` warning that ADR-0160's split note describes. That warning fires for a skill with `mcpPrompt: false` that declares `context`; it ends once the name is listed.

## Order with cloud
- A group in `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE` must be the exact set one cloud package registers, so this lands together with cloud#4978.
- Merge this PR first, without a release-visible effect; the list only annotates.
- cloud#4978's pin move then picks it up, in the same pin bump that ships the registration.
- If cloud#4978 is delayed, this PR waits in draft. It does not merge alone into a release.

## Acceptance
- The platform-tool-names pin tests and the i18n completeness check pass.
- The lint rule no longer warns on `get_record_context`.
- cloud#4978's PR names this PR's merge sha in its pin move.

## Out of scope
- The cloud registration itself (cloud#4978).
- MCP door tool names: `MCP_DOOR_TOOL_NAMES` lands in #37140.

Blocked-by: #37140. It lands with objectstack-ai/cloud#4978.
Parent: #36996. Reader: the spec and i18n lane.
Dedupe: `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE get_record_context` 1 (#37140, which adds the MCP door name only) · `get_record_context i18n label` 1 (the seat post, no card).
